pages.text: In this ritual an $(#ad03fc)afrit$() will possess an $(#ad03fc)Old Zombified Piglin$(),$(br) unifying the energies of the $(#ad03fc)nether$(), the power of the $(#ad03fc)afrit$(),$(br)  the material $(#ad03fc)pork$() and the concept of the color $(#ad03fc)pink$().$(br) This is the only known method to $()
obtain $(item)Demonic Meat$(), its properties$(br)  prevent cooking but grant fire resistance to whoever consumes it.$(br)
